- **self**: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing (16/5)

## How it works

- [statement] The primary backup region and each additional copy region receive their own storage SKU: Atlas Cloud Backup Storage for snapshots only, or Atlas Continuous Cloud Backup Storage when continuous backup is enabled in that region. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
- [statement] Snapshots normally share unchanged data. Deleting one snapshot releases billable unique data only when no retained snapshot still references it. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The documented AWS us-east-1 continuous-backup example charges $106.25/month for 115 GB combined storage: 5 GB free, 95 GB at $1.00, and 15 GB at $0.75. This is an illustrative region-specific schedule. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB documents disabling and reenabling continuous backup as a way to prevent dual-region billing, but disabling it deletes continuous-backup history. Existing snapshots remain intact; this trade-off sacrifices historical PIT restore coverage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/tutorial/move-cluster.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup.md, https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas budgets include backup and transfer costs alongside cluster configuration costs; backup is not covered solely by the cluster tier. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-mongodb-atlas/costs-licenses.html · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/, https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-pricing-explained-what-youre-really-paying-for/
- [statement] Atlas Core Cloud Backups charge retained snapshot storage by provider and storage region. GB-month rates appear as daily GB-days; repeated daily rows do not imply duplicate charges. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/inefficiencies/excessive-snapshot-retention-and-cross-region-copies-in-mongodb-atlas-cloud-backup
- [statement] Continuous Cloud Backup bills combined snapshot and internal backup-oplog storage using provider-, region-, and usage-tier-dependent rates. Longer restore windows increase retained oplog storage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/what-is-tier-1-or-tier-2-in-atlas-continuous-cloud-backup-storage-billing-line/122754/2, https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] Additional-region copies add cross-region transfer and destination storage charges. Copying all backups to one additional region approximately doubles storage quantity; differing regional rates can change the cost ratio. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/inefficiencies/excessive-snapshot-retention-and-cross-region-copies-in-mongodb-atlas-cloud-backup
- [statement] Atlas stores continuous-backup oplogs in the snapshot region, normally the cluster or shard highest-priority region. Sharded deployments create separate backups for each shard in its primary region. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/snapshot-distribution.md
- [statement] After a highest-priority-region change or an oplog-region migration, Atlas temporarily retains and bills backup storage in both regions. It removes old-region data once the new region represents the complete continuous-backup window. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/tutorial/move-cluster.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup.md
- [statement] Snapshot storage is incremental where possible. A topology, node, tier, volume, or region change can require another full snapshot and raise retained backup storage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/dedicated-cluster-backup/
- [statement] Copy-region policy items can enable oplog copying for PIT restore after a regional outage. Oplog distribution is configured at the copy-region level, applying to every snapshot copy policy in that region. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/snapshot-distribution.md · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
- [statement] PointFive recommends assigning backup frequency, retention, and regional copies according to environment criticality and recovery needs, then checking existing-snapshot retention updates and compliance-policy minimums before estimating savings. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/inefficiencies/excessive-snapshot-retention-and-cross-region-copies-in-mongodb-atlas-cloud-backup · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
- [statement] A Reddit user reported continuous backup at about half their Atlas bill. This is one unverified customer anecdote, not a typical cost share or current pricing benchmark. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/mongodb/comments/gw9up1 · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
- [statement] OutageDeck archives a MongoDB incident identified and resolved on April 27, 2026: a billing bug inflated some April 24 backup charges without affecting backup configuration, cluster health, or data; MongoDB promised invoice corrections and refunds. (low confidence) — https://outagedeck.com/incidents/mongodb-atlas-increase-in-billing-for-backup-usage-2026-04-27 · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
- [statement] Snapshot copy policies separately specify copy frequency, retention and whether to copy oplogs for PIT recovery in the destination region. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/snapshot-distribution.md · keywords: Backup and PIT oplog storage region billing
